scope: Variant identifiers and semantics only; family count, family allocation, track weights, tiers, repeats, exclusions, stopping rules, and statistical rules remain unchanged.

canonical_execution_variants.role: exactly one registered family axis is changed
canonical_execution_variants.ranking_policy: Use the case-card quality tier after single-factor validation.

canonical_execution_variants.role: required evidence is absent or an explicitly registered anomaly prevents a unique answer
canonical_execution_variants.ranking_policy: Always Silver; exclude from the main ranking; score abstention diagnostics only.

legacy_v1_crosswalk.reason: A control perturbation is not semantically equivalent to missing or anomalous evidence. Materializing this legacy id from a missing_or_anomalous case is prohibited.

invalidation_rule: Any run that maps single_factor_control to missing_or_anomalous, omits the diagnostic variant, or uses a variant id outside this protocol is invalid and must not enter reporting or ranking.
